weights: 1+eta for query tokens above within-query 75th-percentile feature distance from query mean; 1 for others; divide by sum of weights
inputs: frozen query vectors only; no coordinates, OCR, identity or truth
bound: sum-subset upper=min(sum token norm upper, N*mean minus outside lower); lower analogous
selection: validation identity macro R@1 then MRR then smaller eta
evaluated_scope: all gallery rows bounded; exact scores for every row that may enter top10 or outrank any positive; stable SHA dedup
full_scalar_scores_for_low_bound_rows: not computed; explicitly NaN and accompanied by rigorous bounds
